role: Validated parsing of LLM-supplied numeric tool arguments: FactNumericArgument declares each parameter's name/range/integrality and throws FactArgumentError (an invalidParameter FactValue) for non-finite, out-of-range or fractional input; also splits comma-separated parameter lists.
types: FactNumericArgument: struct — numeric parameter declaration + parser
FactArgumentError: struct (Error, Equatable) — rejected argument carrying the model-facing detail
state: static let startingATL/startingCTL/dailyTrimp (0…10000), gapTrimp (0…10000, lower excluded), horizonDays (1…365 int), latitude (-90…90), longitude (-180…180), segmentRadiusMeters (5…5000), ordinal (0…100000 int), lookbackSeconds (1…86400 int), maxResults (1…10 int) — lines 103-122
toplevel: Declares 11 static FactNumericArgument constants (lines 103-122) used by TrainingProjections, WorkoutDetail, Workout, Sessions, WorkoutLiveDerived and Settings resolvers.

units.does: Memberwise init storing name, range, excludesLowerBound (default false) and integral (default false).
Trims the raw text, parses Double, and returns it only if finite and accepted by the range/integral rules; otherwise throws FactArgumentError '<name> must be <requirement>, got '<first 40 chars>''.

branches.cond: Double parse fails, value not finite, or not accepted

units.does: Parses via value(_:) then converts with Int(exactly:); throws if not exactly representable.

branches.effect: throws FactArgumentError '<name> must be <requirement>' (unreachable for integral params since value() already rejected fractions and ranges are ≤100000)

flags.text: The Int(exactly:) guard at line 42 cannot fail for any caller: integer(_:) is only called on integral parameters (ordinal, maxResults, lookbackSeconds, horizonDays), whose value(_:) already rejected fractions and bounded the value to at most 100000.

units.does: True when value is in range, not equal to an excluded lower bound, and (if integral) whole.

branches.cond: outside range or equals excluded lower bound
branches.effect: returns false; otherwise returns !integral || value is whole

units.does: Human description of the accepted values, e.g. 'a whole number from 1 to 365' or 'a finite number above 0 and at most 10000'.

branches.effect: kind 'a whole number' else 'a finite number'
'above X and at most Y' else 'from X to Y'

units.does: Formats a bound with no decimals when whole, else String(bound).
Splits on commas keeping empty fields, trims whitespace, and throws 'expected <format>, got '<first 80 chars>'' unless the field count is in counts and no field is empty.

branches.cond: field count not in counts or any field empty
branches.effect: throws FactArgumentError; otherwise returns trimmed parts
